# Deploy Finance

> Deploy makes capital productive: deposit USDC and it earns by default while staying liquid,
> composable, and non-custodial. Autonomous agents put the capital to work on decentralized
> perpetual markets (e.g. capturing funding rates); custody stays with the user. Infrastructure
> running since 2018.

Important: this file is a stable summary. Exact fees, minimums, supported markets, and any
yields/returns are NOT listed here — fetch them live from the official docs, never from memory.
Deploy is non-custodial, does not give personalized financial advice, and guarantees no returns.
